title: PXAPI product diagnosis v1
description: Prioritised product recommendations derived from the contextual diagnosis (Confluence 39846055 §11). The overall intervention level is a judgement on the website as a whole, from MONITOR to REDESIGN, with EVIDENCE_FIRST when the evidence is too thin to recommend any intervention: there is no automatic redesign bias. Every recommendation is justified by at least one contextual-diagnosis claim, states its priority by rank and by explicit factors, and may only be customer-facing if it has passed the strategic relevance question (customer_facing true implies strategic_relevance true). No formula combining the factors into a rank is part of this contract. An empty recommendations array means no recommendation was made; it is never a finding about the website.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this product diagnosis belongs to.

generated_at.description: Required. When the product diagnosis was generated.

overall_intervention_level.description: Required. The intervention level judged for the website as a whole. MONITOR: no intervention, keep observing. MAINTENANCE: small corrective work within the existing website. TARGETED_MODERNIZATION: focused modernisation of specific areas. REDESIGN: a full redesign is justified by the evidence. EVIDENCE_FIRST: the evidence is insufficient to recommend an intervention; gather evidence before deciding.

recommendations.description: Required. The prioritised recommendations. An empty array means no recommendation was made; it never means the website needs nothing, and it never means anything was not assessed.

recommendation_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this recommendation; the customer projection and other recommendations reference it.

title.description: Required. A single-line title of the recommendation.

rationale.description: Required. Why the recommendation is made, in business language, grounded in the referenced claims.

intervention_level.description: Required. The intervention level of this single recommendation, on the same scale as overall_intervention_level. It may differ from the overall level: one targeted recommendation does not imply a redesign.

priority_rank.description: Required. The recommendation's position in the prioritised list; 1 is the highest priority. How the rank follows from the priority factors is not part of this contract.

strategic_relevance.description: Required. Whether the recommendation passed the strategic relevance question (Confluence 39846055 §3.5): does it matter for the entrepreneur's business, not only for the website? Must be true for a customer-facing recommendation.

business_impact.description: Required. The expected effect on the business if the recommendation is implemented.

urgency.description: Required. How soon the recommendation should be acted on.

effort.description: Required. The estimated effort of implementing the recommendation.

evidence_strength.description: Required. How strongly the referenced claims support the recommendation, on the 0..5 scale.

dependencies.description: Required. The recommendation_ids of the recommendations in this document that this one depends on. An empty array means the recommendation depends on no other.

priority_factors.description: Required. The explicit factors behind the rank, stated so that the prioritisation is reviewable. No formula combining them is part of this contract.

claim_refs.description: Required. The claim_ids of the contextual-diagnosis claims that justify the recommendation. At least one is required: a recommendation without a justifying claim is invalid, so an empty array is rejected.

customer_facing.description: Required. Whether the recommendation is shown to the customer. True only if strategic_relevance is true; a recommendation that failed the strategic relevance question stays internal.
